messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

Loan Approval Process.
New loan applications arrive every 10 minutes on average (exponential inter-arrival distribution).
Steps:
1. Receive Application - service task, fixed 2 minutes, no resource needed.
2. Credit Check - service task, normal distribution mean 15 min std 3 min,
   performed by Credit Analyst. 2 Credit Analysts available.
3. Review Decision - exclusive gateway:
   - 70%: Approved -> Prepare Offer
   - 30%: Rejected -> Send Rejection
4. Prepare Offer - user task, uniform 10-20 min, Loan Officer (1 available).
5. Send Rejection - service task, fixed 5 min, no resource.
Both paths end at: Application Closed. Simulate for 8 hours.

  <bpmn:process id="LoanApprovalProcess" name="Loan Approval Process" isExecutable="true">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveToCredit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToCredit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToCredit" sourceRef="StartEvent_ReceiveApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplication" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreditCheck" name="Credit Check">
      <bpmn:resourceRole resourceRoleName="Performer">
        <bpmn:resourceAssignmentExpression>
          <bpmn:formalExpression>Credit Analyst</bpmn:formalExpression>
        </bpmn:resourceAssignmentExpression>
      </bpmn:resourceRole>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToDecisionGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCheck" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApplication" targetRef="Task_CreditCheck" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Review Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToDecisionGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDecisionGateway" sourceRef="Task_CreditCheck" targetRef="Gateway_Decision" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareOffer" name="Prepare Offer">
      <bpmn:resourceRole resourceRoleName="Performer">
        <bpmn:resourceAssignmentExpression>
          <bpmn:formalExpression>Loan Officer</bpmn:formalExpression>
        </bpmn:resourceAssignmentExpression>
      </bpmn:resourceRole>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferToClose</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved (70%)" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_PrepareOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${Math.random() < 0.7}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RejectionToClose</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected (30%)" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_SendRejection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${Math.random() >= 0.7}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ApplicationClosed" name="Application Closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferToClose</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RejectionToClose</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToClose" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOffer" targetRef="EndEvent_ApplicationClosed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectionToClose" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_ApplicationClosed" />
